_comment: Anchored text edits to src/Global.lua, applied by tools/tts_build.py --arno. Each 'find' must occur exactly once, otherwise the build fails (protects against silent mis-patching after a base-mod update). Edits are for changes inside a function body or to the mod's static panel text and data; behaviour before or after a whole function (mostly ARNO-only branches) stays a wrapper in arno/adapter/*.lua. ARNO calls are guarded with `ARNO and`. Listed in CHANGES.md.

hooks.why: Add ARNO bots to `players` before setup_game builds per-colour components, so bot colours keep their boards, counters and tokens.
hooks.find:
table.insert(players, { color = player.color, steam_name = player.steam_name })
  end
hooks.replace:
table.insert(players, { color = player.color, steam_name = player.steam_name })
  end
  if ARNO then ARNO.setup.add_bots(players) end

hooks.why: ARNO 3.0: a human player is always the starting player.
hooks.replace: local starting_player = (ARNO and ARNO.setup.starting_player(players)) or players[math.random(#players)]

hooks.why: start_game waits for 4 discards per player; humans discard 4, ARNO discards his setup cards (not 4).
Card 471 African Spurred Tortoise: the base data lacks its Reptile House option (printed card: Reptile House 2, like the other size-3 reptiles 476/481). Upstream mod fix, applied in every game.
hooks.find: [471] = {type="animal", size=3, cost=22, icons={"reptile", "africa"}, rewards={"1 cp", "6 appeal", "sunbathing 3"}},
hooks.replace: [471] = {type="animal", size=3, cost=22, icons={"reptile", "africa"}, enclosure={repthouse=2}, rewards={"1 cp", "6 appeal", "sunbathing 3"}},

hooks.why: destruct_action_card_decks: ARNO's action cards were dealt from his colour's zone in his own setup, so that zone has no deck left; skip missing decks (crash before the setup discard, found in play). Harmless without ARNO.
hooks.replace: local zone = getObjectFromGUID(guid); local deck = zone and getDeck(zone); if deck ~= nil then deck.destruct() end

hooks.why: wait_for_all_hand_counts: ARNO has no hand, so only human hands are waited for.
Owner request, every game: the action panel sits flush right like the mod's other panels (base: 60 px in).
Owner request, every game: the action panel grows 22 px for the undo hint line.
Owner request, every game: one undo hint line at the bottom of the action panel.
